name: mychain
title: My Chain
_note: Copy this file to profiles/<name>.json and fill it in. Keys starting with _ are comments.
filter_note: One regex. Proper names match without $. Ticker words that are also English words (index, torch, earn) need $ or ALL CAPS. Add community nicknames ('mc', 'my chain s2') or posts using them are missed. Emerging names (>= 3 authors mention a new @handle) pass automatically at the community tier.
tiers_note: core: official accounts and team, every post is read. projects: apps and their founders, every post is read, their numbers are self-reported. community: people whose posts move the conversation, scanned in groups of 5. Score candidates by views per post, share of on-topic posts and whether others quote them. Start with 30 to 60 community accounts.
recap_note: Daily recap bots are scanned but not ranked: they crowd the top views and have no view of their own.
_categories_note: Ordered by priority: each post takes the first matching label as its main topic. Labels are hints for reading, not a verdict.

runner.data: DEX hourly OHLCV for the token, top pools, holder count
runner.chart: step_event: hourly mcap with event markers
runner.hook: X went from $a to $b in N hours, here is what moved it

smart_money.data: RPC transfer logs of the token, wallet funding sources
smart_money.chart: ranked_bars: share held by top wallets
smart_money.hook: N wallets hold X%, funded from the same source

yield.data: pool volume and TVL by day, fee tier, price change over the same period
yield.chart: paired_bars or diverging: fees vs price loss per pool
yield.hook: $10K in these pools 30 days ago made $X after price

growth.data: DefiLlama chain TVL, DEX volume, app revenue by day for this chain and a peer
growth.hook: At the same age, this chain is ahead of/behind Peer

listing.data: price and volume around the listing hour
listing.hook: What a listing did to price and volume, hour by hour

angle_types.compare: one measure across 5 to 8 tokens or apps, one number each
angle_types.correct: a claim that is spreading, checked, with the right number
angle_types.onchain: an on-chain number nobody has posted: custody wallets, holders, who bought the red day
angle_types.angle: the side of a hot story few look at: everyone says A, the data shows B comes with it
angle_types.money: a way to earn or a thesis: LP, yield, valuation

stance_rules: Write your stance here, for example: supportive of the ecosystem when the numbers allow it, never unconditional.
Outsiders attacking with wrong numbers: answer publicly with the right numbers.
Insiders or projects overstating: do not dunk. 'The real number is X, still good because Y', or a friendly reply instead of a post.
Project posts are self-reported: say so and treat them as numbers to check.
